body: A mobile battery smoked on a Hong Kong Express flight from Hong Kong bound for Jeju, injuring one passenger. Jeju Fire Safety Headquarters received a report at around 6:22 a.m. on October 25 that a passenger had been burned after a mobile battery heated up and smoked on the Hong Kong Express aircraft scheduled to land at Jeju International Airport (CJU); the aircraft was still in flight when the report was made.

There were 243 people on board, including 236 passengers and seven crew members. Fire authorities arrived at Jeju International Airport at around 6:32 a.m. and stood by until the aircraft landed. According to headquarters, a Chinese woman in her 50s had stored the mobile battery in a bag under her seat; smoke came from the battery, and she burned her left thumb while taking it out.

The crew immediately placed the smoking battery into the aircraft's heat-resistant containment bag for battery fires and immersed it in water. After fire authorities confirmed there was no further fire risk inside the cabin, the injured passenger received first aid; she declined transport and said she would go to a hospital on her own.
en.summary: A mobile battery stored in a bag under a passenger's seat smoked on a Hong Kong Express flight bound for Jeju; the passenger burned her left thumb while removing it, and the crew sealed the battery in a heat-resistant containment bag and immersed it in water.
en.title: Mobile battery smokes on Hong Kong Express flight to Jeju, leaving one passenger with a burned thumb

body: 香港出發前往濟州的香港快運班機上，發生行動電源冒煙事件。濟州消防安全本部於25日上午6時22分左右接獲通報，內容是預定降落濟州國際機場（CJU）的香港出發香港快運班機上，因行動電源發熱冒煙而有乘客燙傷；通報當時班機仍在飛行中。
機上共有243人，包括乘客236人與機組員7人。消防當局於上午6時32分左右抵達濟州國際機場待命，直到班機降落為止。據消防本部說法，1名50多歲的中國籍女性乘客放在座位下方袋內的行動電源冒煙，她在取出的過程中左手拇指燙傷。
機組員立即把冒煙的行動電源放進機上專用的耐熱收納袋並浸水處置。消防當局確認機內沒有進一步起火危險後，才對傷者進行應急處置；傷者拒絕送醫，表示會自行前往醫院。
zh.summary: 香港出發前往濟州的香港快運班機上，1名乘客座位下方袋內的行動電源冒煙，取出的過程中左手拇指燙傷；機組員以耐熱收納袋裝載並浸水處置，確認無進一步起火危險後班機降落濟州。
zh.title: 香港快運飛往濟州班機行動電源冒煙、1名乘客燙傷左手拇指
